name: interfaze
description: Accurate, verifiable output in one call. Interfaze is a model built for deterministic tasks: OCR for images, PDFs and Word documents, speech-to-text, object and GUI detection with bounding boxes, web search and scraping, translation, classification and forecasting, in 100+ languages. This plugin connects your agent to the hosted Interfaze MCP server and adds skills that pick the right tool for each job.
